requiredFindings.title: Upward ancestors bypass all downward population restrictions
requiredFindings.finding: The adapter unconditionally unions ancestors and opensip.json children of cwd, explicitProject, explicitResolved and accountHome into keep before applying downward rules. These entries are never removed. With an explicit project, selection does not walk cwd, yet cwd can reintroduce a hidden repository beneath .opensip or an unrelated sibling into SLM finish. The output-path-is-in-population property accepts the leak because the forbidden paths were first inserted into the population.

reproductions.invocation: explicitProject=/h/w, cwd=/h/w/.opensip/hidden-repo, accountHome=/h; synthetic custody-passing directories and vcs=True on hidden-repo
reproductions.actual: current returns ACCEPT and nestedRepositories=["/h/w/.opensip/hidden-repo"]. The population also retains /h/w/.opensip/opensip.json when supplied.

reproductions.invocation: explicitProject=/h/w, explicitJoins=[a/u], cwd=/h/w/b/repo, with a/u/package.json and vcs=True on b/repo
reproductions.actual: current returns ACCEPT but retains /h/w/b and /h/w/b/repo and reports the unrelated repository.

requiredFindings.requiredChange: Derive the upward evidence actually used by selection, rather than all possible ancestor chains. Keep upward-selection evidence separate from the downward fs presented to finish so genuine upward observations cannot bypass pruning, boundary, exact-source or depth limits. In explicit-project mode, unrelated cwd/accountHome ancestors must not become downward observations. Add direct population and result assertions for both reproductions and an overlap with the depth stop. Preserve selected-root/upward provenance and rerun every replay and schema check.

requiredFindings.title: Unexpected current-replay exceptions do not fail the checker
requiredFindings.finding: Exceptions from rule-swapped discovery or current are appended as EXCEPTION rows followed by continue, without adding to failures. Since passed and the exit status depend only on failures, a broken replay or the current root/source consistency error can silently skip that case and its schema/population checks while the checker reports success. discoveryCases is incremented before this block, so it does not prove successful coverage.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Fail on every unexpected exception in a discovery case. If any case intentionally expects an instrument exception, require an explicit case-specific expected exception and validate it; do not blanket-skip. Assert the exact successful replay and validation counts and the four explicitly classified non-discovery cases. Add a negative checker control proving that a current-replay consistency exception prevents passed=true and a zero exit status.
